question: Does the Liu-Moon-Schorfheide empirical-Bayes dynamic panel forecaster beat the Y-9C baselines one quarter ahead on three FR Y-9C income-statement lines for the top-50 BHC panel?

method.label: Empirical-Bayes dynamic panel (LMS Tweedie posterior mean)
method.citation: Liu, Laura, Hyungsik Roger Moon, and Frank Schorfheide. Forecasting with Dynamic Panel Data Models. NBER Working Paper 25102 (2018); Econometrica 88(1), 171-201 (2020).
method.paper_predictor_followed: Posterior mean predictor with QMLE common parameters and parametric (Gaussian correlated-random-effects) Tweedie correction; the LMS empirical application's preferred predictor (Section 7.1, Tables 7-9).
method.equation: y_it = lambda_i + rho * y_i,t-1 + alpha' s_t + u_it,  u_it ~ iid N(0, sigma^2)
method.transform: y_it = 400 * X_it / A_i,t-1: the de-cumulated quarterly flow X (thousands USD) divided by the bank's own BHCK2170 total assets at the previous calendar quarter-end, annualized percent (LMS scale PPNR by assets times 400). Lagged assets are used so that the level forecast needs only A_it, known at origin t. Calendar-key lookups; no bridging of gaps.
method.seasonal_regressors: s_t = (1{q(t)=1}, 1{q(t)=2}, 1{q(t)=3}) - 1/4, common coefficients alpha across banks, deterministic calendar terms known in advance. LMS remove seasonality by annual time aggregation; a one-quarter-ahead quarterly forecast cannot, so centered quarter-of-year dummies enter as common regressors Z (LMS eq. 1). With T = 12 each quarter appears three times, so s_t averages to zero over the window.
method.window: Rolling: at origin t the estimation sample for bank i is y_i,t-11..y_it (T = 12 equations) with initial condition y_i0 = y_i,t-12 (LMS use rolling samples of T+1 observations plus the target).
method.estimation_cross_section: Banks selected into the top 50 by BHCK2170 at origin t (y9c.forecast.design rule, RSSD tie-break) that have all 13 ratios y_i,t-12..y_it observed. Selection uses only data dated <= t and never depends on target (t+1) availability.
method.correlated_random_effects: lambda_i | y_i0 ~ N(phi0 + phi1 * y_i0, omega^2), omega^2 >= 0
method.estimation: QMLE (LMS eq. 24): maximize the integrated Gaussian likelihood jointly over (rho, alpha, sigma^2, phi0, phi1, omega^2). (phi0, phi1, sigma^2, omega^2) are profiled in closed form given (rho, alpha); (rho, alpha) are found numerically. Refit at every origin on data dated <= t only.
method.tweedie: Posterior mean E[lambda_i | lambda_hat_i, y_i0] = lambda_hat_i + (sigma^2 / T) * d/d lambda_hat log p_hat(lambda_hat_i | y_i0), where lambda_hat_i = mean over the window of (y_it - rho y_i,t-1 - alpha' s_t) and p_hat is the estimated marginal density of the sufficient statistic, N(phi0 + phi1 y_i0, omega^2 + sigma^2 / T) (LMS eqs. 17, 20, 30).
method.forecast: yhat_i,t+1 = E[lambda_i | .] + rho * y_it + alpha' s_t+1, with all estimates from the origin-t fit
method.fallback: An evaluation case whose bank lacks the complete 13-ratio window (entry, missing or non-positive lagged assets, missing de-cumulated flow) receives the naive forecast; counts are reported per line.
method.no_tuning: T, transform, regressors, prior family and estimator are fixed here. No trimming, winsorizing, clipping or case removal; nonfinite forecasts raise an error.

units: thousands USD; quarterly flows de-cumulated from calendar-year YTD by the shared y9c panel code (y9c.panel.decumulate)
universe: Top 50 BHCs by reported BHCK2170 at each origin t, RSSD ID breaks ties; identical to Y-9C (y9c.forecast.design).
evaluation_cases: Per line, the Y-9C case rule from y9c.forecast: bank selected at origin t, target X_t+1 observed, X_t and X_t-3 observed. All four methods are scored on exactly the same cases within a line.

baselines.source: Imported from y9c.forecast (not reimplemented): naive Xhat_t+1 = X_t; seasonal naive Xhat_t+1 = X_t-3; pooled AR on log growth g(s+1) = a + b1 g(s) + b4 g(s-3), expanding pooled OLS on historical top-50 rows with s+1 <= t, naive fallback when log inputs are missing or non-positive.

metrics: MAE and RMSE in thousands USD, equal weight per BHC-quarter (y9c.forecast.metrics). Displayed in whole thousands.
dm_test: y9c.forecast.clustered_dm: d = L(baseline) - L(eb_panel) for absolute and squared error (error = forecast - actual), CR1 standard error clustered by target quarter, two-sided p from Student t(G-1). Positive mean favors eb_panel. Computed per line against each of the three baselines on the full sample; per-year versions are descriptive only.

pass_bar.rule: For a given line, eb_panel PASSES iff MAE(eb_panel) < MAE(naive) AND the full-sample clustered DM two-sided p-value on absolute error (naive vs eb_panel) <= 0.05. An undefined p-value is a FAIL.

headline: Per-line PASS/FAIL verdict for all three lines; the headline states how many of the 3 lines pass.
descriptive_only: Comparisons with seasonal naive and pooled AR
multiple_testing: No multiplicity adjustment across lines or losses; each line has its own pre-registered verdict.
timing_limitation: Report-quarter backtest on currently downloaded NIC filings, as in Y-9C: period-t filings are treated as available at t; filing lags and later revisions are not modeled.
runs: Synthetic and unit tests first; then the real-data evaluation is run once and published whatever the result.
